title: RBI Notifies Payments Banks Statutory Audit Directions 2026 Prescribing Auditor Appointment and LFAR Requirements
description: RBI issued the Payments Banks Statutory Audit Directions, 2026 prescribing auditor appointment, eligibility, governance, LFAR requirements and audit procedures.The post RBI Notifies Payments Banks Statutory Audit Directions 2026 Prescribing Auditor Appointment and LFAR Requirements appeared first on TaxGuru.
